answer: Because the glacier beacon round is committed in advance, the harbor audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the whisper value does not exist until the window has already shut. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 10 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
